caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic teapot or coffeepot centered on a plain, light-colored background. The pot has a tall, cylindrical body with a slightly domed, ornate lid featuring a decorative finial at the top. The spout is long, narrow, and curves upward, attached near the upper half of the body. The handle is large, curved, and attached at the top and near the base of the main body on the right side. The body of the pot is rendered in shades of blue and gray, with darker accents to suggest shadows and highlights, giving it a somewhat reflective appearance. The lid, base, and rim of the spout are bordered with darker metallic colors, possibly intended to represent brass or another metal. There are no additional objects or background elements; the focus remains entirely on the pot.
title: Pewter Coffee Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
